About Sane Living Center

A beautiful sacred space in the heart of Ojai, where people come together to learn, connect and grow.

Founder — Aubrey Balkind

1944 – 2025

As the founder of Ojai’s Sane Living Center, Aubrey Balkind envisioned a future where humans live in harmony with both nature and artificial intelligence.

Read More →
Public Art

The EVO 3 Sculpture

Standing over 8 feet tall on East Matilija Street in Ojai, California, the EVO 3 Sculpture offers viewers the story of humanity — from its biological root through its egocentric development to its algorithmically-defined future — in the form of a giant metallic question mark with a drum integrated into its base.

Created by Sane Living founder Aubrey Balkind and built by artist Ray Cerino, the EVO 3 Sculpture was welcomed by the Ojai City Council in 2018.

Rooted in Community

Non-Profits We Support

Opening our doors to the organizations that bring meaningful programming to Ojai. Free and low-cost gatherings that nourish mind, body and community.

Our Community

The Organizations

Groups bringing meaningful programming to the Sane Living Center. Tap any one to visit their website.

Jewish Community of Ojai

A welcoming community synagogue in the Ojai Valley that honors tradition while embracing new approaches to Jewish life, with Shabbat and holiday services, Torah study and gatherings for all ages.

Visit website →

Ojai Valley Chamber of Commerce

Championing local businesses and helping visitors discover the best of the Ojai Valley, from shops and restaurants to community events.

Visit website →

Alliance for Regenerative Communities

An open network of individuals, groups and companies working together to advance sustainable practices and regenerative solutions.

Visit website →

Sierra Club of Santa Barbara – Ventura

The local chapter of the Sierra Club, leading outdoor outings and conservation work across Santa Barbara and Ventura counties, from public lands to clean energy.

Visit website →

Ojai Valley Land Conservancy

The Ojai Valley’s land trust, protecting and restoring the natural landscapes that make the valley special, with public preserves, trails and creek restoration for everyone to enjoy.

Visit website →

Donate

Donate Now →
The Sane Community Project

Building a Saner Community

A non-profit initiative that opens the doors of the Sane Living Center to everyone.

The Sane Community Project offers free and subsidized events that nourish mind, body and community. Rooted in the Sane Living philosophy of balancing Bio, Ego and Algo, it’s built on a simple belief: reconnecting with each other and with nature is the most hopeful path forward.

Our programming brings together wellness practitioners, artists, educators and neighbors to share knowledge, build relationships and strengthen the fabric of our community.

“Reconnecting to nature can be our grounding touchstone to bring Bio, Ego and Algo into a healthier balance.”

Aubrey Balkind, Founder

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Community Events — Sane Living Center</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Upcoming public events and recent events at the Sane Living Center in Ojai, California. Film screenings, workshops, performances, and community gatherings.">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/style.css">
  <link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
  <style>
    /* Calendar-specific styles — adapted from sanecommunity.org */
    .cal-wrap {
      max-width: 900px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, sans-serif;
    }

    .cal-header {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      margin-bottom: 16px;
      gap: 10px;
    }

    .cal-nav {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 8px;
    }

    .cal-nav button {
      background: var(--clr-bg-card, #f7f7f7);
      border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
      border-radius: 8px;
      padding: 6px 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #333;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .cal-nav button:hover {
      background: #f3ecf9;
      border-color: #c48eff;
      color: #8a56a0;
    }

    .cal-month-label {
      font-size: 1.1rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #111;
      min-width: 160px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .cal-view-toggle {
      display: flex;
      background: #f7f7f7;
      border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .cal-view-toggle button {
      background: none;
      border: none;
      padding: 6px 14px;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 0.8rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: #777;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .cal-view-toggle button.active {
      background: #8a56a0;
      color: #fff;
    }

    .cal-view-toggle button:hover:not(.active) {
      color: #8a56a0;
    }

    /* Grid View */
    .cal-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(7, 1fr);
      border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
      border-radius: 8px;
      overflow: hidden;
    }

    .cal-dow {
      background: #f7f7f7;
      padding: 8px 4px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
      color: #777;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
    }

    .cal-cell {
      min-height: 80px;
      border-right: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
      padding: 4px;
      position: relative;
    }

    .cal-cell:nth-child(7n) { border-right: none; }
    .cal-cell.other-month { background: #f7f7f7; }
    .cal-cell.other-month .cal-day-num { color: #999; }
    .cal-cell.today { background: #f3ecf9; }

    .cal-day-num {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #333;
      padding: 2px 4px;
      display: inline-block;
    }

    .cal-cell.today .cal-day-num {
      background: #8a56a0;
      color: #fff;
      border-radius: 50%;
      width: 22px; height: 22px;
      display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    }

    .cal-event-dot {
      display: block;
      padding: 2px 4px;
      margin: 1px 0;
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: #edd8ff;
      color: #7b22cc;
      white-space: nowrap;
      overflow: hidden;
      text-overflow: ellipsis;
      cursor: pointer;
      text-decoration: none;
      transition: background 0.15s;
    }

    .cal-event-dot:hover { background: #dab8ff; }

    /* List View */
    .cal-list { display: none; }
    .cal-list.active { display: block; }
    .cal-grid-wrap.active { display: block; }
    .cal-grid-wrap { display: none; }

    .cal-list-month {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
      color: #8a56a0;
      padding: 12px 0 6px;
      border-bottom: 2px solid #edd8ff;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
    }

    .cal-list-item {
      display: flex;
      gap: 12px;
      padding: 10px 8px;
      border-bottom: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      border-radius: 8px;
    }

    .cal-list-item:hover { background: #f3ecf9; }

    .cal-list-date {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 48px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .cal-list-date .day-num {
      font-size: 1.3rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #111;
      line-height: 1.2;
    }

    .cal-list-date .day-name {
      font-size: 0.65rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #777;
    }

    .cal-list-info { flex: 1; min-width: 0; }

    .cal-list-title {
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #111;
    }

    .cal-list-meta {
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: #777;
      margin-top: 2px;
    }

    .cal-list-type {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: #edd8ff;
      color: #7b22cc;
      margin-left: 6px;
      vertical-align: middle;
    }

    .cal-empty {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 40px 20px;
      color: #777;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
    }

    .cal-loading {
      text-align: center;
      padding: 60px 20px;
      color: #999;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
    }

    /* Fliers View */
    .cal-fliers { display: none; }
    .cal-fliers.active { display: block; }

    .cal-fliers-grid {
      columns: 2;
      column-gap: 12px;
    }

    .cal-flier-card {
      break-inside: avoid;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      border-radius: 10px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: #fff;
      border: 1px solid #e0e0e0;
      transition: box-shadow 0.15s;
    }

    .cal-flier-card:hover {
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0,0,0,0.08);
    }

    .cal-flier-img {
      width: 100%;
      display: block;
    }

    .cal-flier-body {
      padding: 10px 12px;
    }

    .cal-flier-title {
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #111;
      margin-bottom: 4px;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .cal-flier-meta {
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      color: #777;
      line-height: 1.4;
    }

    .cal-flier-badges {
      display: flex;
      gap: 4px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: 6px;
    }

    .cal-flier-badge {
      font-size: 0.6rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 2px 6px;
      border-radius: 3px;
      background: #edd8ff;
      color: #7b22cc;
    }

    .cal-flier-badge.price {
      background: #f0f0f0;
      color: #333;
    }

    .cal-flier-no-img {
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #edd8ff, #f3ecf9);
      padding: 24px 16px;
      text-align: center;
    }

    .cal-flier-no-img .cal-flier-placeholder {
      font-size: 1.2rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #8a56a0;
    }

    /* Modal */
    .cal-modal-overlay {
      display: none;
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
      backdrop-filter: blur(2px);
      z-index: 2000;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 20px;
      animation: calFadeIn 0.15s ease;
    }

    .cal-modal-overlay.active { display: flex; }

    @keyframes calFadeIn {
      from { opacity: 0; }
      to { opacity: 1; }
    }

    @keyframes calSlideUp {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(12px); }
      to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); }
    }

    .cal-modal {
      background: #fff;
      border-radius: 12px;
      max-width: 440px;
      width: 100%;
      max-height: 80vh;
      overflow-y: auto;
      box-shadow: 0 8px 40px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.15);
      animation: calSlideUp 0.2s ease;
    }

    .cal-modal-header {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      justify-content: space-between;
      padding: 20px 20px 0;
      gap: 12px;
    }

    .cal-modal-title {
      font-size: 1.15rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      color: #111;
      line-height: 1.3;
    }

    .cal-modal-close {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 28px; height: 28px;
      border: none;
      background: #f0f0f0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      cursor: pointer;
      font-size: 1rem;
      color: #555;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      transition: all 0.15s;
    }

    .cal-modal-close:hover { background: #e0e0e0; color: #111; }

    .cal-modal-body { padding: 16px 20px 20px; }

    .cal-modal-row {
      display: flex;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: 8px;
      padding: 6px 0;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: #333;
    }

    .cal-modal-row + .cal-modal-row {
      border-top: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
    }

    .cal-modal-icon {
      flex-shrink: 0;
      width: 18px;
      text-align: center;
      font-size: 0.9rem;
      line-height: 1.5;
    }

    .cal-modal-label {
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #777;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      margin-bottom: 2px;
    }

    .cal-modal-desc {
      padding: 10px 0;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      color: #333;
      line-height: 1.6;
      border-top: 1px solid #f0f0f0;
    }

    .cal-modal-badges {
      display: flex;
      gap: 6px;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      padding: 8px 0;
    }

    .cal-modal-badge {
      display: inline-block;
      font-size: 0.7rem;
      font-weight: 700;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: 4px;
      background: #edd8ff;
      color: #7b22cc;
    }

    .cal-modal-badge.price {
      background: #f0f0f0;
      color: #333;
    }

    .cal-modal-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 6px;
      margin-top: 12px;
      padding: 10px 20px;
      background: #8a56a0;
      color: #fff;
      border: none;
      border-radius: 8px;
      font-family: inherit;
      font-size: 0.85rem;
      font-weight: 600;
      text-decoration: none;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s;
      width: 100%;
      justify-content: center;
    }

    .cal-modal-cta:hover { background: #7b22cc; }

    .cal-modal-image {
      width: 100%;
      border-radius: 8px;
      margin-bottom: 12px;
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: opacity 0.15s;
    }

    .cal-modal-image:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .cal-cell { min-height: 60px; }
      .cal-event-dot { font-size: 0.55rem; padding: 1px 3px; }
      .cal-month-label { font-size: 0.95rem; min-width: auto; }
      .cal-header { gap: 8px; }
      .cal-modal { max-height: 90vh; }
      .cal-fliers-grid { columns: 1; }
    }

    @media (min-width: 700px) {
      .cal-fliers-grid { columns: 3; }
    }

    /* ==== V2 DESIGN POLISH (DESIGN.md) — appended overrides ==== */
    .cal-wrap { background: #fff; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(42,26,51,.10); padding: 22px; }
    .cal-grid { border: none; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 1px #e7ddf0; }
    .cal-dow { background: #2a1a33; color: #e9def3; font-size: 0.72rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; padding: 10px 4px; }
    .cal-cell { transition: background 0.2s ease; }
    .cal-cell:hover { background: #faf6fd; }
    .cal-cell.today { box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #8a56a0; border-radius: 6px; background: #f7f0fb; }
    .cal-event-dot { background: #8a56a0; color: #fff; border-radius: 999px; padding: 3px 8px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; }
    .cal-event-dot:hover { background: #7a489a; transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .cal-nav button, .cal-view-toggle button { border-radius: 999px; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s ease; }
    .cal-nav button:hover { transform: translateY(-1px); }
    .cal-list-item { border-radius: 12px; transition: background 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease; cursor: pointer; }
    .cal-list-item:hover { transform: translateX(3px); }
    .cal-modal { border-radius: 16px !important; box-shadow: 0 24px 60px rgba(42,26,51,.28) !important; overflow: hidden; }
    .cal-modal-header { background: linear-gradient(120deg, #2a1a33, #5b3573); color: #fff; }
    .cal-modal-title { color: #fff; }
    .cal-modal-close { background: rgba(255,255,255,.18); color: #fff; border-radius: 50%; }
    .cal-modal-close:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.32); color: #fff; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .cal-cell, .cal-event-dot, .cal-list-item { transition: none; } }
    /* ---- Combined Events page: section headings, Recent Events flyer wall, flyer viewer ---- */
    .section-eyebrow { display: block; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--clr-accent); margin-bottom: var(--space-md); }
    .events-head { text-align: center; max-width: 680px; margin: 0 auto var(--space-xl); }
    .events-head h2 { margin-bottom: var(--space-sm); }
    .events-head p { margin: 0 auto; font-size: 1.05rem; }
    /* The page title already says "Events", so Recent Events is a small label rather than a second big heading */
    .events-head h2.recent-label { font-family: var(--font-body); font-size: 12.5px; line-height: 1.4; margin-bottom: 0; }
    .events-head .recent-label + .events-jump { margin-top: var(--space-sm); }
    .events-jump { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; margin-top: var(--space-md); font-size: 12.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--clr-plum); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--clr-accent); padding-bottom: 5px; }
    .events-jump:hover { color: var(--clr-accent); }
    .recent-grid { columns: 4 220px; column-gap: 18px; }
    .recent-card { display: block; break-inside: avoid; margin-bottom: 18px; border-radius: 14px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--clr-bg-card); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); cursor: zoom-in; transition: transform 0.3s ease, box-shadow 0.3s ease; }
    .recent-card img { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; border-radius: 0; }
    .recent-card:hover, .recent-card:focus-visible { transform: translateY(-4px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-lift); }
    .recent-card:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--clr-accent); outline-offset: 3px; }
    .recent-grid.collapsed .recent-card:nth-child(n+13) { display: none; }
    .recent-more { text-align: center; margin-top: var(--space-lg); }
    .recent-more[hidden] { display: none; }
    .intensive-feature { max-width: 900px; margin: clamp(3rem, 7vw, 5rem) auto 0; text-align: center; padding-top: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.5rem); border-top: 1px solid var(--clr-border); }
    .intensive-feature img { width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); margin-bottom: var(--space-lg); }
    .flyer-viewer { border: 0; padding: 0; background: transparent; max-width: min(92vw, 900px); max-height: 92vh; overflow: visible; }
    .flyer-viewer::backdrop { background: rgba(20, 16, 22, 0.88); }
    .flyer-viewer img { display: block; max-width: 100%; max-height: 88vh; width: auto; height: auto; margin: 0 auto; border-radius: 10px; }
    .flyer-close { position: fixed; top: 16px; right: 16px; width: 46px; height: 46px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); color: #fff; font-size: 1.7rem; line-height: 1; cursor: pointer; }
    .flyer-close:hover, .flyer-close:focus-visible { background: rgba(255,255,255,0.3); outline: none; }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .recent-card { transition: none; } }

    /* ============ COMMUNITY EVENTS — V4 "day into night" (Oct 30, 2026) ============ */
    .ev-wrap { max-width: var(--max-width); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--space-lg); }
    #upcoming, #recent, #updates { scroll-margin-top: calc(var(--nav-height) + 16px); }
    /* Opening photo */
    .video-hero.events-hero { position: relative; min-height: max(560px, 70vh); background: var(--clr-night); color: var(--clr-on-night); overflow: hidden; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; }
    .events-hero > img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; border-radius: 0; }
    .events-hero-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.72) 0%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.3) 55%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.1) 100%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.6) 0%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0) 26%),
        linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.95) 0%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.55) 34%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0) 64%); }
    .events-hero-copy { position: relative; width: 100%; padding: calc(var(--nav-height) + 56px) 0 clamp(3.5rem, 9vh, 5.5rem); }
    .events-hero h1 { font-size: clamp(2.8rem, 6vw, 5.2rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.02; color: var(--clr-on-night); margin: 0 0 var(--space-lg); }
    .events-hero h1 em { display: block; font-weight: 500; color: var(--clr-glow); }
    .events-hero p { font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem); line-height: 1.65; color: #e6dcea; max-width: 36rem; margin: 0 0 var(--space-xl); }
    .events-jumps { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px 22px; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; }

  <script>
  (function() {
    var events = [];
    var eventsById = {};
    var currentDate = new Date();
    var currentView = 'fliers';

    var DAYS = ['Sun','Mon','Tue','Wed','Thu','Fri','Sat'];
    var FULL_DAYS = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'];
    var MONTHS = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];

    function setEvents(list) {
      events = (list || []).slice();
      eventsById = {};
      events.forEach(function(e, i) {
        if (!e.id) e.id = 'event-' + i;
        if (typeof e.image === 'string') e.image = { url: e.image, thumbnail: e.image };
        eventsById[e.id] = e;
      });
      render();
    }

    function loadEvents() {
      document.getElementById('calGrid').innerHTML = '<div class="cal-loading" style="grid-column:1/-1;">Loading events...</div>';
      // Events come from Airtable via /api/calendar-events — the site's one
      // calendar sync. (No separate events file: Airtable is authoritative.)
      fetch('/api/calendar-events')
        .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function(data) { setEvents(data.events || []); })
        .catch(function() {
          document.getElementById('calGrid').innerHTML = '<div class="cal-empty" style="grid-column:1/-1;">Could not load events.</div>';
        });
    }

    function render() {
      if (currentView === 'grid') renderGrid();
      else if (currentView === 'list') renderList();
      else if (currentView === 'fliers') renderFliers();
    }

    function renderGrid() {
      var year = currentDate.getFullYear();
      var month = currentDate.getMonth();
      document.getElementById('monthLabel').textContent = MONTHS[month] + ' ' + year;

      var firstDay = new Date(year, month, 1).getDay();
      var daysInMonth = new Date(year, month + 1, 0).getDate();
      var daysInPrev = new Date(year, month, 0).getDate();

      var today = new Date();
      var todayStr = today.getFullYear() + '-' + pad(today.getMonth()+1) + '-' + pad(today.getDate());

      var html = '';
      for (var d = 0; d < 7; d++) {
        html += '<div class="cal-dow">' + DAYS[d] + '</div>';
      }

      var totalCells = Math.ceil((firstDay + daysInMonth) / 7) * 7;
      for (var i = 0; i < totalCells; i++) {
        var dayNum, dateStr, isOther = false;
        if (i < firstDay) {
          dayNum = daysInPrev - firstDay + i + 1;
          var pm = month === 0 ? 11 : month - 1;
          var py = month === 0 ? year - 1 : year;
          dateStr = py + '-' + pad(pm+1) + '-' + pad(dayNum);
          isOther = true;
        } else if (i >= firstDay + daysInMonth) {
          dayNum = i - firstDay - daysInMonth + 1;
          var nm = month === 11 ? 0 : month + 1;
          var ny = month === 11 ? year + 1 : year;
          dateStr = ny + '-' + pad(nm+1) + '-' + pad(dayNum);
          isOther = true;
        } else {
          dayNum = i - firstDay + 1;
          dateStr = year + '-' + pad(month+1) + '-' + pad(dayNum);
        }

        var isToday = dateStr === todayStr;
        var cls = 'cal-cell';
        if (isOther) cls += ' other-month';
        if (isToday) cls += ' today';

        html += '<div class="' + cls + '">';
        html += '<span class="cal-day-num">' + dayNum + '</span>';

        var dayEvents = events.filter(function(e) { return e.date === dateStr; });
        dayEvents.forEach(function(e) {
          html += '<span class="cal-event-dot" data-event-id="' + e.id + '" title="' + escapeHtml(e.title) + '">' + escapeHtml(e.title) + '</span>';
        });
        html += '</div>';
      }
      document.getElementById('calGrid').innerHTML = html;
    }

    function renderList() {
      var allEvents = events.filter(function(e) { return e.date; }).sort(function(a, b) {
        return a.date < b.date ? -1 : a.date > b.date ? 1 : 0;
      });

      if (allEvents.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('calList').innerHTML = '<div class="cal-empty">Fall Calendar Pending</div>';
        return;
      }

      var html = '<div class="cal-list-month">Upcoming Community Events</div>';
      allEvents.forEach(function(e) {
        var dt = new Date(e.date + 'T12:00:00');
        var dayName = DAYS[dt.getDay()];
        var monthShort = MONTHS[dt.getMonth()].substring(0, 3);
        var dayNum = dt.getDate();
        var typeLabel = e.price ? e.price : (e.type === 'free' ? 'Free' : e.type);
        var meta = '';
        if (e.startTime) meta += e.startTime;
        if (e.endTime) meta += ' - ' + e.endTime;
        if (e.location) meta += (meta ? ' | ' : '') + e.location;

        html += '<div class="cal-list-item" data-event-id="' + e.id + '">';
        html += '<div class="cal-list-date"><div class="day-name">' + monthShort + '</div><div class="day-num">' + dayNum + '</div></div>';
        html += '<div class="cal-list-info">';
        html += '<div class="cal-list-title">' + escapeHtml(e.title);
        if (typeLabel) html += '<span class="cal-list-type">' + typeLabel + '</span>';
        html += '</div>';
        if (meta) html += '<div class="cal-list-meta">' + escapeHtml(meta) + '</div>';
        html += '</div></div>';
      });
      document.getElementById('calList').innerHTML = html;
    }

    function renderFliers() {
      var allEvents = events.filter(function(e) { return e.date; }).sort(function(a, b) {
        return a.date < b.date ? -1 : a.date > b.date ? 1 : 0;
      });

      if (allEvents.length === 0) {
        document.getElementById('calFliers').innerHTML = '<div class="cal-empty">Fall Calendar Pending</div>';
        return;
      }

      var html = '<div class="cal-fliers-grid">';
      allEvents.forEach(function(e) {
        var dt = new Date(e.date + 'T12:00:00');
        var dayName = DAYS[dt.getDay()];
        var dayNum = dt.getDate();
        var monthName = MONTHS[dt.getMonth()];

        html += '<div class="cal-flier-card">';
        if (e.image && e.image.thumbnail) {
          html += '<a href="' + escapeHtml(e.image.url) + '" target="_blank"><img src="' + escapeHtml(e.image.thumbnail) + '" alt="' + escapeHtml(e.title) + '" class="cal-flier-img"></a>';
        } else {
          html += '<div class="cal-flier-no-img"><div class="cal-flier-placeholder">' + escapeHtml(e.title) + '</div></div>';
        }

        html += '<div class="cal-flier-body">';
        html += '<div class="cal-flier-title">' + escapeHtml(e.title) + '</div>';

        var meta = dayName + ', ' + monthName + ' ' + dayNum;
        if (e.startTime) meta += ' | ' + e.startTime;
        if (e.endTime) meta += ' - ' + e.endTime;
        html += '<div class="cal-flier-meta">' + escapeHtml(meta) + '</div>';

        if (e.location) {
          html += '<div class="cal-flier-meta">' + escapeHtml(e.location) + '</div>';
        }

        var hasBadge = e.type || e.price;
        if (hasBadge) {
          html += '<div class="cal-flier-badges">';
          if (e.type) {
            var typeText = e.type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + e.type.slice(1);
            html += '<span class="cal-flier-badge">' + escapeHtml(typeText) + '</span>';
          }
          if (e.price) {
            html += '<span class="cal-flier-badge price">' + escapeHtml(e.price) + '</span>';
          }
          html += '</div>';
        }

        if (e.blurb) {
          html += '<div class="cal-flier-meta" style="margin-top:6px;font-style:italic;color:#555;">' + escapeHtml(e.blurb) + '</div>';
        }
        if (e.description) {
          html += '<div class="cal-flier-meta" style="margin-top:4px;">' + escapeHtml(e.description) + '</div>';
        }
        if (e.rsvpUrl) {
          html += '<a href="' + escapeHtml(e.rsvpUrl) + '" target="_blank" class="cal-modal-cta" style="margin-top:10px;font-size:0.75rem;padding:8px 14px;">More Info</a>';
        }

        html += '</div></div>';
      });

      html += '</div>';
      document.getElementById('calFliers').innerHTML = html;
    }

    // Modal
    function showModal(eventId) {
      var e = eventsById[eventId];
      if (!e) return;

      document.getElementById('modalTitle').textContent = e.title;
      var body = '';

      if (e.image && e.image.url) {
        body += '<a href="' + escapeHtml(e.image.url) + '" target="_blank"><img src="' + escapeHtml(e.image.thumbnail || e.image.url) + '" alt="' + escapeHtml(e.title) + '" class="cal-modal-image"></a>';
      }

      if (e.date) {
        var dt = new Date(e.date + 'T12:00:00');
        var dateDisplay = FULL_DAYS[dt.getDay()] + ', ' + MONTHS[dt.getMonth()] + ' ' + dt.getDate() + ', ' + dt.getFullYear();
        var timeDisplay = '';
        if (e.startTime) timeDisplay = e.startTime;
        if (e.endTime) timeDisplay += ' - ' + e.endTime;
        body += '<div class="cal-modal-row"><div><div class="cal-modal-label">Date & Time</div>' + escapeHtml(dateDisplay);
        if (timeDisplay) body += '<br>' + escapeHtml(timeDisplay);
        body += '</div></div>';
      }

      if (e.location) {
        body += '<div class="cal-modal-row"><div><div class="cal-modal-label">Location</div>' + escapeHtml(e.location) + '</div></div>';
      }

      if (e.type || e.price) {
        body += '<div class="cal-modal-badges">';
        if (e.type) {
          var typeText = e.type.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + e.type.slice(1);
          body += '<span class="cal-modal-badge">' + escapeHtml(typeText) + '</span>';
        }
        if (e.price) {
          body += '<span class="cal-modal-badge price">' + escapeHtml(e.price) + '</span>';
        }
        body += '</div>';
      }

      if (e.blurb) {
        body += '<div class="cal-modal-desc" style="font-style:italic;color:#555;">' + escapeHtml(e.blurb) + '</div>';
      }
      if (e.description) {
        body += '<div class="cal-modal-desc">' + escapeHtml(e.description) + '</div>';
      }
      if (e.rsvpUrl) {
        body += '<a href="' + escapeHtml(e.rsvpUrl) + '" target="_blank" class="cal-modal-cta">More Info</a>';
      }

      document.getElementById('modalBody').innerHTML = body;
      document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.add('active');
    }

    function closeModal() {
      document.getElementById('modalOverlay').classList.remove('active');
    }

    document.getElementById('modalClose').addEventListener('click', closeModal);
    document.getElementById('modalOverlay').addEventListener('click', function(ev) {
      if (ev.target === this) closeModal();
    });
    document.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev) {
      if (ev.key === 'Escape') closeModal();
    });

    document.addEventListener('click', function(ev) {
      var dot = ev.target.closest('[data-event-id]');
      if (dot) { ev.preventDefault(); showModal(dot.getAttribute('data-event-id')); }
    });

    // View toggle
    function switchView(view) {
      currentView = view;
      ['gridViewBtn', 'listViewBtn', 'fliersViewBtn'].forEach(function(id) {
        document.getElementById(id).classList.remove('active');
      });
      var containers = { grid: 'gridWrap', list: 'calList', fliers: 'calFliers' };
      Object.keys(containers).forEach(function(v) {
        document.getElementById(containers[v]).classList.remove('active');
      });
      var btnId = view === 'grid' ? 'gridViewBtn' : view === 'list' ? 'listViewBtn' : 'fliersViewBtn';
      document.getElementById(btnId).classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById(containers[view]).classList.add('active');
      document.getElementById('prevBtn').style.display = view === 'grid' ? '' : 'none';
      document.getElementById('nextBtn').style.display = view === 'grid' ? '' : 'none';
      document.getElementById('monthLabel').style.display = view === 'grid' ? '' : 'none';
      render();
    }

    document.getElementById('gridViewBtn').addEventListener('click', function() { switchView('grid'); });
    document.getElementById('listViewBtn').addEventListener('click', function() { switchView('list'); });
    document.getElementById('fliersViewBtn').addEventListener('click', function() { switchView('fliers'); });

    document.getElementById('prevBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
      currentDate.setMonth(currentDate.getMonth() - 1); render();
    });
    document.getElementById('nextBtn').addEventListener('click', function() {
      currentDate.setMonth(currentDate.getMonth() + 1); render();
    });

    function pad(n) { return n < 10 ? '0' + n : '' + n; }
    function escapeHtml(s) {
      if (!s) return '';
      return s.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"');
    }

    loadEvents();
  })();
  </script>
  <script>
  // Recent Events: show the first 12 flyers, open any flyer large on the page, and add flyers of past
  // events from Airtable (with a flyer image) to the front of the wall.
  (function() {
    var grid = document.getElementById('recentGrid'), more = document.getElementById('recentMore'), wrap = document.getElementById('recentMoreWrap');
    var dlg = document.getElementById('flyerViewer'), img = document.getElementById('flyerImg');
    function esc(s) { return String(s || '').replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"'); }
    function sync() { wrap.hidden = !grid.classList.contains('collapsed') || grid.children.length <= 12; }
    grid.classList.add('collapsed'); sync();
    more.addEventListener('click', function() { grid.classList.remove('collapsed'); sync(); });
    grid.addEventListener('click', function(e) {
      var a = e.target.closest('[data-flyer]');
      if (!a || typeof dlg.showModal !== 'function') return;
      e.preventDefault(); img.src = a.getAttribute('href'); img.alt = (a.querySelector('img') || {}).alt || ''; dlg.showModal();
    });
    document.getElementById('flyerClose').addEventListener('click', function() { dlg.close(); });
    dlg.addEventListener('click', function(e) { if (e.target === dlg) dlg.close(); });
    fetch('/api/calendar-events-past').then(function(r) { return r.ok ? r.json() : null; }).then(function(data) {
      var html = ((data && data.events) || []).filter(function(e) { return e.image && (e.image.url || e.image.thumbnail); }).map(function(e) {
        var full = e.image.url || e.image.thumbnail, thumb = e.image.thumbnail || full;
        return '<a class="recent-card" href="' + esc(full) + '" data-flyer><img src="' + esc(thumb) + '" alt="' + esc('Flyer: ' + (e.title || 'event')) + '" loading="lazy"></a>';
      }).join('');
      if (html) { grid.insertAdjacentHTML('afterbegin', html); sync(); }
    }).catch(function() {});
  })();
  </script>
</body>
</html>

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8">
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
  <title>Sane Living Center — Host Your Event in the Heart of Ojai</title>
  <meta name="description" content="Sane Living Center — a beautiful auditorium and gathering venue in the heart of Ojai, California. Events, workshops, film screenings, and more.">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/style.css">
  <style>
    /* ============ HOME — V4 "day into night" (Oct 29, 2026) ============ */
    .home-wrap { max-width: var(--max-width); margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 var(--space-lg); }
    .home-h2 { font-size: clamp(2.3rem, 4.2vw, 3.4rem); font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.08; margin: 0; }
    .home-lede { font-size: 1.1rem; line-height: 1.7; max-width: 38rem; }

    /* ---- 1. Hero: the Auditorium video across the full width ---- */
    .video-hero {
      position: relative;
      min-height: 620px;
      height: 100vh;
      height: 100svh;
      max-height: 1000px;
      background: var(--clr-night);
      color: var(--clr-on-night);
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-pair { position: absolute; inset: 0; display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    .hero-half { position: relative; overflow: hidden; }
    .hero-half video, .hero-half img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; border-radius: 0; }
    .hero-half video { pointer-events: none; }
    .hero-scrim {
      position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: 1; pointer-events: none;
      background:
        linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.7) 0%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.35) 45%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0) 70%),
        linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.55) 0%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0) 22%),
        linear-gradient(0deg, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.97) 0%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.75) 30%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0) 62%);
    }
    .hero-copy {
      position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; z-index: 2;
      padding-bottom: clamp(3.5rem, 9vh, 6rem);
    }
    .hero-copy .eyebrow { color: var(--clr-glow); }
    .hero-copy h1 {
      font-size: clamp(2.9rem, 6.4vw, 5.6rem);
      font-weight: 600;
      line-height: 1.0;
      color: var(--clr-on-night);
      max-width: 20ch;
      margin: 0 0 var(--space-lg);
    }
    .hero-copy h1 em { display: block; font-weight: 500; color: var(--clr-glow); }
    .hero-copy h1 + .hero-actions { margin-top: var(--space-xl); }
    .hero-copy .hero-subtitle { font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.5vw, 1.2rem); line-height: 1.65; color: #e6dcea; max-width: 38rem; margin: 0 0 var(--space-xl); }
    .hero-actions { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-md); }

    @media (max-width: 760px) {
      .video-hero { height: auto; max-height: none; min-height: 0; }
      .hero-pair { position: relative; height: 340px; }
      .hero-scrim { background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.6) 0%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0) 30%); bottom: auto; height: 340px; }
      .hero-copy { position: relative; padding: var(--space-xl) 0 var(--space-2xl); }
    }

    /* ---- 2. Upcoming Public Events (auto-hidden when empty) ---- */
    .events-section { display: none; }
    .events-section.has-events { display: block; }
    .events-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: var(--space-md); margin-bottom: var(--space-xl); }
    .events-grid { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-lg); }
    .event-card { display: flex; background: var(--clr-bg-card); border: 1px solid var(--clr-border); border-radius: 18px; overflow: hidden; transition: transform 0.2s, box-shadow 0.2s; }
    .event-card:hover { transform: translateY(-3px); box-shadow: var(--shadow-soft); }
    .event-card-img { width: 280px; min-height: 280px; object-fit: cover; flex-shrink: 0; border-radius: 0; }
    .event-card-body { padding: var(--space-xl); display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: center; flex: 1; min-width: 0; }
    .event-card-date { font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 800; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.14em; color: var(--clr-accent); margin-bottom: var(--space-xs); }
    .event-card-title { font-family: var(--font-display); font-size: 1.7rem; font-weight: 600; line-height: 1.15; color: var(--clr-plum); margin-bottom: var(--space-sm); }
    .event-card-meta { font-size: 0.95rem; color: var(--clr-text-muted); line-height: 1.55; }
    .event-card-cta { display: inline-block; margin-top: var(--space-md); padding: 10px 22px; background: var(--clr-accent); color: #fff; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 0.9rem; font-weight: 700; align-self: flex-start; transition: background 0.2s; }
    .event-card-cta:hover { background: var(--clr-accent-hover); color: #fff; }
    @media (max-width: 600px) {
      .event-card { flex-direction: column; }
      .event-card-img { width: 100%; min-height: 200px; height: 200px; }
    }

    /* ---- 3. Why here: three pillars, open columns (no boxes) ---- */
    .pillars-head { text-align: center; max-width: 46rem; margin: 0 auto clamp(2.75rem, 6vw, 4rem); }
    .pillars { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(3, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 4.5rem); }
    .pillar { border-top: 1px solid var(--clr-plum); padding-top: var(--space-lg); }
    .pillar .pillar-icon { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 3.25rem; height: 3.25rem; border-radius: 50%; border: 1px solid var(--clr-accent); color: var(--clr-accent); margin: 0 0 var(--space-md); }
    .pillar .pillar-icon svg { width: 1.6rem; height: 1.6rem; }
    .pillar h3 { font-size: clamp(1.75rem, 2.5vw, 2.15rem); margin: 0 0 var(--space-sm); }
    .pillar .sample-note { font-style: italic; font-weight: 700; color: var(--clr-accent); }
    .pillar p { margin: 0; font-size: 1.05rem; line-height: 1.75; color: var(--clr-text-muted); }
    @media (max-width: 900px) { .pillars { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--space-xl); } }

    /* ---- Photo strips between sections ---- */
    .photo-strip { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr 1.4fr; gap: 6px; height: clamp(240px, 30vw, 420px); background: var(--clr-bg); }
    .photo-strip > * { position: relative; display: block; margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    .photo-strip img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; border-radius: 0; transition: transform 0.8s var(--ease-soft); }
    .photo-strip > *:hover img, .photo-strip > a:focus-visible img { transform: scale(1.04); }
    .photo-strip > a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--clr-glow); outline-offset: -3px; }
    .photo-strip figcaption, .photo-strip .strip-cap { position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 32px 16px 12px; color: #fff; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.75), rgba(31, 19, 40, 0)); }
    .photo-strip-night { background: var(--clr-night); }
    @media (max-width: 760px) {
      .photo-strip { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; grid-auto-rows: 180px; height: auto; }
      .photo-strip > *:first-child { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
      .photo-strip > *:nth-child(4) { grid-column: 1 / -1; }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .photo-strip img { transition: none; } }

    /* ---- 4. A day in the life of one space: full-bleed photo panels that darken from morning to night ---- */
    #any-hour { padding-bottom: 0; }
    .hours-head { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: var(--space-md); margin-bottom: clamp(2rem, 4vw, 2.75rem); }
    .hours-link { font-weight: 700; color: var(--clr-accent); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--clr-accent); padding-bottom: 4px; }
    .hours { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)); gap: 3px; background: var(--clr-night); }
    .hour-card { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: flex-end; min-height: clamp(420px, 44vw, 620px); overflow: hidden; color: #fff; text-decoration: none; isolation: isolate; }
    .hour-card img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block; border-radius: 0; z-index: -2; transition: transform 1s var(--ease-soft); }
    .hour-card::before { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; z-index: -1; transition: opacity 0.4s ease; }
    .hour-morning::before { background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(42, 26, 51, 0.82) 0%, rgba(42, 26, 51, 0.15) 55%, rgba(42, 26, 51, 0) 100%); }
    .hour-afternoon::before { background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(42, 26, 51, 0.86) 0%, rgba(42, 26, 51, 0.25) 55%, rgba(42, 26, 51, 0.08) 100%); }
    .hour-evening::before { background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.92) 0%, rgba(74, 47, 88, 0.5) 55%, rgba(74, 47, 88, 0.3) 100%); }
    .hour-late::before { background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(21, 12, 27, 0.95) 0%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.6) 55%, rgba(31, 19, 40, 0.45) 100%); }
    .hour-card:hover img, .hour-card:focus-visible img { transform: scale(1.06); }
    .hour-card:hover { color: #fff; }
    .hour-card-body { padding: clamp(1.5rem, 2.6vw, 2.25rem); }
    .hour-time { display: block; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.08em; text-transform: none; margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--clr-glow); }
    .hour-morning .hour-time, .hour-afternoon .hour-time { color: #f3ece2; }
    .hour-card h3 { font-size: clamp(1.7rem, 2.3vw, 2.2rem); margin: 0 0 8px; color: #fff; }
    .hour-card p { margin: 0; font-size: 0.98rem; line-height: 1.6; color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.86); max-width: 22rem; }
    @media (max-width: 1000px) { .hours { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)); } }
    @media (max-width: 520px) { .hours { grid-template-columns: 1fr; } .hour-card { min-height: 380px; } }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .hour-card img { transition: none; } }

    /* ---- 5. Ways to book (evening) ---- */
    .book-head { max-width: 44rem; margin-bottom: clamp(2.25rem, 4.5vw, 3rem); }

  <script>
  (function() {
    // --- Upcoming Public Events: Airtable via /api/calendar-events (the site's
    // calendar sync — Airtable is the single source for events). ---
    function todayStr() {
      var n = new Date();
      return n.getFullYear() + '-' + String(n.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0') + '-' + String(n.getDate()).padStart(2, '0');
    }
    function upcoming(list) {
      var t = todayStr();
      return (list || []).filter(function(e) { return e && e.title && (!e.date || e.date >= t); })
        .sort(function(a, b) { return (a.date || '') < (b.date || '') ? -1 : 1; });
    }
    function loadHomeEvents() {
      return fetch('/api/calendar-events')
        .then(function(r) { return r.json(); })
        .then(function(data) { return upcoming(data.events); });
    }
    loadHomeEvents()
      .then(function(allEvents) {
        var events = (allEvents || []).slice(0, 3); // show max 3
        if (events.length === 0) return;

        var section = document.getElementById('eventsSection');
        var grid = document.getElementById('eventsGrid');
        section.classList.add('has-events');

        var DAYS = ['Sunday','Monday','Tuesday','Wednesday','Thursday','Friday','Saturday'];
        var MONTHS = ['January','February','March','April','May','June','July','August','September','October','November','December'];

        var html = '';
        events.forEach(function(e) {
          var dt = new Date(e.date + 'T12:00:00');
          var dateStr = DAYS[dt.getDay()] + ', ' + MONTHS[dt.getMonth()] + ' ' + dt.getDate() + ', ' + dt.getFullYear();

          html += '<div class="event-card">';

          if (typeof e.image === 'string') e.image = { url: e.image, thumbnail: e.image };
          if (e.image && e.image.thumbnail) {
            html += '<a href="' + escHtml(e.image.url || e.image.thumbnail) + '" target="_blank"><img src="' + escHtml(e.image.thumbnail) + '" alt="' + escHtml(e.title) + '" class="event-card-img"></a>';
          }

          html += '<div class="event-card-body">';
          html += '<div class="event-card-date">' + escHtml(dateStr) + '</div>';
          html += '<div class="event-card-title">' + escHtml(e.title) + '</div>';

          var meta = '';
          if (e.startTime) meta += e.startTime;
          if (e.endTime) meta += ' - ' + e.endTime;
          if (e.location) meta += (meta ? ' | ' : '') + e.location;
          if (meta) html += '<div class="event-card-meta">' + escHtml(meta) + '</div>';

          if (e.blurb) {
            html += '<div class="event-card-meta" style="margin-top:6px;">' + escHtml(e.blurb) + '</div>';
          }

          if (e.rsvpUrl) {
            html += '<a href="' + escHtml(e.rsvpUrl) + '" target="_blank" class="event-card-cta">More Info</a>';
          }

          html += '</div></div>';
        });

        grid.innerHTML = html;
      })
      .catch(function() { /* silently hide events section */ });

    function escHtml(s) {
      if (!s) return '';
      return s.replace(/&/g,'&').replace(/</g,'<').replace(/>/g,'>').replace(/"/g,'"');
    }
  })();

The EVO 3 Sculpture

Standing over 8 feet tall on East Matilija Street in Ojai, California, the EVO3 Sculpture offers viewers the story of humanity — from its biological root through its egocentric development to its algorithmically-defined future — in the form of a giant metallic question mark with a drum integrated into its base.

Created by Sane Living founder Aubrey Balkind and built by artist Ray Cerino, the EVO 3 sculpture was welcomed by the Ojai City Council in 2018.
